scope: 12 MP GPU upload cancellation at validation and admission boundaries with old Metal frame retention and successful replacement recovery
checks: Canceled upload returns Cancelled at every exercised checkpoint
Every canceled upload retains full old visible frame and its 16-byte reservation
Temporary replacement and upload queue credit return to baseline after cancellation
Successful upload after cancellations renders expected blue center and changes frame
Old GPU image reservation releases after successful replacement
GPU and upload queue budgets return to zero after renderer drop
limitations: Six selected checkpoints out of 2933 are exercised for the large source; every checkpoint only for the small source
Driver allocation/write calls are not interruptible after final pre-driver cancellation check
Old/new frame readback is 128x96, not full-size raster
Constant authored replacement does not qualify diverse decoding or all formats
Source CPU vectors are independent test allocations outside GPU/queue budgets
SDR offscreen test does not qualify physical HDR display
Ignored full-camera corpus/manual tests are unverified by ordinary regression
